# Phase 10 — Observability

## Vision
Provide end-to-end operational visibility for AI routing, orchestration, tools, and runtime health.

## Scope boundaries
- AI decision logs
- Tool execution logs and latency metrics
- Error and retry analytics
- Crash and startup diagnostics

## Dependencies on Phase 1
- Event bus and runtime state store
- Router telemetry hooks
- Structured tool execution events

## Security constraints
- Local-first defaults
- PII-safe log redaction
- Explicit opt-in for remote diagnostics

## Rollout gates
- Internal dashboards and alert thresholds
- Redaction validation
- Performance overhead budget checks

## Success criteria
- Actionable traces for failed tasks
- Reliable latency/cost trend visibility
- Diagnosable provider failovers

## Risks
- Over-collection of sensitive data
- Excessive telemetry overhead
- Inconsistent event schemas across modules
